correctness.rationale: PASS: In F25=F5[e]/(e^2-2), the binary quartic x4-xy3 has four distinct projective roots. Sixteen separated lines and exhaustive 25^4 search for quartic-preserving GL2 graph matrices give 48 additional distinct lines; the characteristic-five Rams-Schütt upper bound of 64 geometrically closes enumeration. Adjunction N_(L/S)=O(-2) proves the finite Fano line set reduced. Exact F25 Gaussian elimination of every pair among 64 lines enumerates 72 planes with four constituent lines, and 144 with two; degree-four intersection means every four-line plane section is precisely four distinct lines. Field Frobenius fixes eight lines and 12 such planes; all other objects are length-two Galois orbits. Exact rational-line incidence degrees (6,6,2,2,2,2,2,2) and 12 edges give K2,6. Independently replicated 48 matrix solutions, all line-pair planes and F5 fixed counts in a fresh F25 program, not simply a verifier exit code.
